narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Gap prioritization applies a 6-factor weighted formula to all 17 categories to produce a ranked Priority Score. Factors: (1) Business Impact — direct revenue/cost/risk effect for Rate (×0.40); (2) Evidence Quality — confidence in the gap assessment (×0.20); (3) Zennify Solution Fit — strength of Zennify's offering for this gap (×0.20); (4) Urgency — regulatory, competitive, or strategic time pressure (×0.20). Each factor scored 1–5. Priority Score = weighted sum, max 5.0.
narrative.recommendations_md:
Six recommendations were independently validated against Rate's confirmed technology stack (Explorium Vibe Prospecting, April 2026 technographic search: rate.com). All 6 solutions confirmed NOT currently in deployment — validating these as genuine open development opportunities. Each recommendation follows the three-part structure: ROOT CAUSE (evidence-grounded) → ZENNIFY SOLUTION (specific Salesforce offering) → EXPECTED OUTCOMES (observable success indicators). No investment amounts per assessment protocol Rule R6.
Section 10 TRANSFORMATION ROADMAP
narrative.roadmap_md: The following phased roadmap sequences all six Zennify recommendations across 12 months, ordered by implementation dependency and business urgency. Phase 1 establishes the data and AI governance foundations that all subsequent work depends upon. Phase 2 delivers the LO productivity and experience layer. Phase 3 completes the platform, strategy, and compliance automation stack. Maturity targets reflect PUBLIC evidence mode baseline (2.24) with internal evidence expected to raise the starting point by +0.5–0.8 points.
